item.tib: yi dam kun 'dus kyi dug phyung dag gtsang nyung 'dus
item.coloph: de ltar gtsang chog nyung 'dus byed pa'i don/ rgyun sgrub sogs la sngon 'gro mang drags pas/ tshig nyung don tshang 'di 'dra zhig dgos par/ lha grogs raDa Na'i mtshan gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ lcags 'brug hor zla dang po'i tshes bzhi la/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan bdag gis sbyar ba'o/ 'dis kyang gang zag sgrub brtson dwangs 'dren nas/ yi dam lha yi khang par gnas byed shog bkra shis nam mkha' ci bzhin rgyas par shog/
